title: Fees for professional or technical services, royalty, and non-compete fees

effectivePeriod.sunsetNotes: Transitions to Section 393(1) Table 6 Item (iii) of Income-tax Act, 2025 effective 1 April 2026.

plainTextSummary: Deduction of tax at source under Section 194J on payments to resident payees. (1) Statutory Rates: (a) Fees for Technical Services (FTS) under Section 194J(1)(a): 2% (reduced by Finance Act, 2020 s. 80); (b) Fees for Professional Services: 10%; (c) Royalty for cinematographic films: 2%; (d) Other royalties and non-compete fees under Section 28(va): 10%. (2) Threshold: ₹30,000 per financial year applied separately to each statutory category. (3) Classification Invariants: Professional services are strictly defined under Section 44AA(1) (legal, medical, engineering, architecture, accountancy, technical consultancy, interior decoration, IT); FTS is defined under Explanation 2 to Section 9(1)(vii) (managerial, technical, or consultancy services). (4) Reclassification Risk & Penalties: If services deducted at 2% (FTS) are recharacterized on assessment as Section 44AA(1) professional services (10%), the deductor is liable for: (a) the 8% differential withholding tax; (b) mandatory penal interest under Section 201(1A) at 1% per month from the date tax was deductible to date deducted and 1.5% from deduction to deposit; and (c) 30% business expenditure disallowance under Section 40(a)(ia) until tax is deposited.

keyStatutoryThresholds.technicalServicesDefinition: Explanation 2 to Section 9(1)(vii) of Income-tax Act, 1961 (managerial, technical, or consultancy services)
keyStatutoryThresholds.professionalServicesDefinition: Section 44AA(1) of Income-tax Act, 1961 (notified professions: legal, medical, engineering, architectural, accountancy, technical consultancy, interior decoration, IT professionals)
keyStatutoryThresholds.penalInterestSection201_1A: 1% per month for delay/shortfall from date deductible; 1.5% per month from date deducted to date deposited
keyStatutoryThresholds.disallowanceSection40_a_ia: 30% expenditure disallowance for failure to deduct or deposit TDS
keyStatutoryThresholds.cbdtCircular23GstExclusion: TDS applies on basic service amount excluding separately stated GST.

officialCitations.instrument: Finance Act, 2020 (Act No. 12 of 2020), Section 80 amending Section 194J(1)
officialCitations.subject: Reduction of TDS rate on Fees for Technical Services (FTS) from 10% to 2%
Exclusion of GST component from value of service for tax deduction at source

requiredDocumentChecklist: Vendor Agreement / Statement of Work verifying scope of work (Pure technical vs. managerial consulting)
Tax invoice with GST separately indicated
Lower-deduction certificate under Section 197 / Section 395 (if lower rate is claimed by vendor)
